title: C · Hangul Foundation & Practice
kind: 16 visual mockups plus source contracts; not runtime integration
authority: Approved C five-tab PNG; latest user request overrides previous app/V3 appearance
invariants: All four stages are available; no invented lock
Audio success + learner confirmation before sound/word save
Correct composition + read confirmation before syllable save
Accepted direction/order/shape of all strokes + confirmation before tracing save
No CEFR mastery, XP, currency or course-unit completion from Foundation
Resume uses currentStep if unfinished then nextStep, and first unpracticed task
A1 choice remains available before and after starter completion
Continue chooses A1 and opens /course/phases with A1, never grants mastery
All Hangul cards open /hangul with overview

screens.name: 입문 시작
actions: Mit Lauten beginnen → /foundation/sounds
each learning station → /foundation/{step.id}
Alle Hangul-Karten → /hangul, overview
A1-Kurs ansehen → chooseContinueA1 + /course/phases, A1
screens.state: 0 practiced tasks. First seal highlights the proposed start, not completion.

screens.name: 소리·자모
actions: Anhören / Noch einmal anhören → _listen(speakableJamo(letter))
confirmation → learner explicitly confirms after successful playback
Übung speichern → savePractice(listen evidence)
screens.state: sound_g representative. Same screen supports sound_n, sound_a, sound_i. Before playback/confirmation save is disabled.

screens.name: 음절 구성 선택
actions: composition rows → _choice
confirmation → read aloud by learner
Übung speichern → savePractice(read evidence)
screens.state: read_ga correct composition selected and confirmed. Use actual stable candidates; read_na/read_han reuse anatomy. Tap options, no mandatory drag.

screens.name: 따라 쓰기·획 피드백
actions: TraceCanvas → evaluateStroke(checkDirection:true)
Löschen → reset stroke state
confirmation → enabled only when all target strokes accepted
Übung speichern → savePractice(trace evidence)
screens.state: trace_a, vertical stroke accepted (1/2); right horizontal stroke next. Save and confirmation are not yet available. trace_g uses one continuous right-then-down stroke.

screens.name: 첫 단어
actions: Anhören → _listen(word)
confirmation → learner said the word
Übung speichern → savePractice(word evidence)
screens.state: word_bag representative. word_tree is the next actual task. Small thumbnails are task context, not invented skip controls.

screens.name: 첫 인사
actions: Anhören → _listen(안녕하세요.)
confirmation → learner said the greeting
Übung speichern → savePractice(word evidence)
screens.state: greeting_hello task 3 of 3 within first_words. No microphone analysis or assessment score.

screens.name: 저장 후 이어하기
actions: Mit Silben weiterlernen → _openStep(syllables), first unpracticed task
stage rows → revisit/open same stable stage
A1-Kurs ansehen → chooseContinueA1 + /course/phases, A1
Alle Hangul-Karten → /hangul, overview
screens.state: Illustrative progress 4/12, all four sounds practiced. Real app must render practicedCount/practicedIn/currentStep/nextStep; never fix these displayed numbers in runtime.

screens.name: 입문 저장 결과·A1 선택
actions: Zum A1-Kurs → chooseContinueA1 + /course/phases, A1
Noch einmal üben → choose a practiced stage, not mark new mastery
Alle Hangul-Karten → /hangul, overview
screens.state: Illustrative progress 12/12 practiced tasks. Starter practice saved, not A1/Hangul mastery. Revisit remains available.

screens.name: 음절표·전체 탐색
actions: /hangul → HangulTarget.overview
14×10=140 basic syllable cells; tap selects and immediately plays composed syllable
Selected cell → consonant+vowel preview → explicit replay
Keep consonant header fixed; horizontal vowel scrolling plus vertical overview scrolling
The same overview continues with 19 consonants, 15 vowels and 한·국·말 composition examples
screens.state: The PNG displays the first 6 rows and 5 vowel columns of a real larger table; it is not the complete data atlas. More rows/columns are native scroll content; audio failures must not disable exploration.

screens.name: 전체 자모·문자 상세
actions: Overview all 19 consonants including double consonants and all current 15 vowels
Character tap → immediate actual Jamo playback plus centered detail dialog
Detail → large true glyph, romanization, descriptionFor(DE/EN), replay and Close
Overview composition examples: 한=ㅎ+ㅏ+ㄴ; 국=ㄱ+ㅜ+ㄱ; 말=ㅁ+ㅏ+ㄹ
screens.state: ㄱ detail sample only. One shared native dialog supports all 34 letters. The underlying full list remains accessible after close; do not bake data into artwork.

screens.name: 카드 앞면
actions: /hangul + HangulTargetDestination(HangulTarget.cards); 19 consonants/15 vowels/16 syllable mode pools
Tap/flip → back; feed gestures remain available with explicit alternatives
Known/unknown judgments disabled until the card is flipped; Skip remains available
Previous, letter playback, random single-card jump
Like and share are separate actions; keep likedContent identity=letter and double-tap like
Finish enabled only after at least one actual session interaction
screens.state: Untouched front sample1/19: knowledge judgments and Finish disabled. The material glyph is a design treatment; actual native letter rendering must stay readable, localized and scalable.

screens.name: 카드 뒷면
actions: Large glyph → romanization → localized description → exampleWord and exampleFor(lang)
Letter listen and example-word listen call different existing speech functions
Unknown → Storage.markHangulHard; Known → Storage.markHangulEasy; both advance
Skip, previous, next/feed, random jump retain existing interaction behavior
Separate like/share, stale-card async guards and platform share recovery
Finish → existing learning attempt/analytics/FeedbackCompletion.hangulCards; actual interactions passed
screens.state: Back sample1/19: flip counts as an interaction so Finish is enabled. This position is not mastery of the entire deck; hangulHard is not a new SRS record.

screens.name: 카드 분류·어려운 글자·음성속도
actions: Choose consonants19, vowels15 or syllables16; apply immediately and close actual mode sheet
Hard-only filter appears only when stored hard items exist; if selected pool becomes empty, fall back to full base pool
Global TtsSpeedAction opens its existing separate speed sheet; choices0.5,0.75,0.8,1,1.25,1.5
Keep current selection, storage semantics and immediate application; no new Apply or Save gate
Random action jumps to one random card; it does not rewrite/shuffle the stored deck
screens.state: Expanded mockup presents mode/filter and speed together to show all controls. Runtime retains separate native sheet entry points and immediate selection callbacks. Sample3 difficult letters is illustrative, never fixed.

screens.name: 전체 자모 쓰기
actions: /hangul + HangulTargetDestination(HangulTarget.write); 19 consonants and15 vowels (34 letters)
Correct current glyph and stroke path; ㄱ is one continuous horizontal-then-down stroke
Rules, options, letter playback, previous/next and real currentIndex/pool length
Real TraceCanvas input; evaluate each stroke for order/shape/length and direction in strict mode
Clear resets current canvas/judgment, preserving completed-session counts
Accepted full letter → correct response → next letter after existing650ms; Finish only when completedLetters>0
screens.state: Initial ㄱ sample1/19 and stroke1/1, zero complete letters: Finish disabled. No Foundation self-confirmation or explicit practice-save gate is added to whole Hangul writing.

screens.name: 쓰기 모드·규칙·오류 피드백
actions: Options → consonants/vowels and persisted Storage.hangulStrictStrokes selection
Strict → direction/order checks, reject only last wrong stroke, retain accepted ink and temporary error ghost
Free practice → direction check off, keep wrong attempt and explain other failures
Rules dialog preserves first-visit seen flag and explicit reopen from Rules
Feedback identifies direction/order/too-short/off-shape in text and stroke state, not by color alone
screens.state: Expanded state board combines existing options, rules and one error example for review. In runtime they remain distinct sheets/inline feedback; changing options does not manufacture a failed stroke.

screens.name: 실제 연습 세션 완료·피드백
actions: Cards finish needs interactions>0; writing finish needs completedLetters>0
Use existing attempt.complete/analytics/abandon hooks and FeedbackCompletion kind
Whole-writing receipt receives completed letters, total stroke attempts and actual strict mode
Show existing Tiger-Check only when ContentFeedbackControllerScope and feature gate are available
Feedback opens current feedback flow; it does not block Close or create a new compulsory survey
Close → actual retained Hangul view, reset correct session state after completion
screens.state: Illustrative writing session3 completed letters/5 total stroke attempts/strict. Attempts may include one rejected stroke; this is not lifetime mastery. Existing reward behavior stays with the original journey/receipt owner; no invented amount.

buildBoundary: PNG mockups are concept approval references. All words, amounts, progress, controls and tracing canvas must be native Flutter later. Do not ship a screenshot with hotspots. Generated character appearance is illustrative; use the existing exact canonical CompanionArt source PNG in runtime. No source/runtime modifications, CI, device or screen-reader QA claimed.

catalogue.note: These are actual current content counts. 12 starter tasks do not replace whole Hangul practice or indicate mastery.
